SELECT A.ASSIGNMENT_ID AS assignmentId, A.COURSE_ID AS courseId, A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE AS assignmentTitle, A.DESCRIPTION AS description, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.DUE_DATE AS dueDate, A.MAX_SCORE AS maxScore, C.COURSE_TITLE AS courseTitle, S.SCORE AS score FROM ASSIGNMENT A JOIN COURSE C ON A.COURSE_ID = C.COURSE_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SCORE FROM ( SELECT ASSIGNMENT_ID, SCORE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY ASSIGNMENT_ID ORDER BY SUBMITTED_DATE DESC, SUBMISSION_ID DESC ) AS RN FROM ASSIGNMENT_SUBMISSION WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ) WHERE RN = 1 ) S ON S.ASSIGNMENT_ID = A.ASSIGNMENT_ID
( A.ASSIGNMENT_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR C.COURSE_TITLE LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' )
ORDER BY A.DUE_DATE ASC
ORDER BY C.COURSE_TITLE ASC
